issues.description: Reconnect loop swallows exceptions and silently rebuilds state with no invariant
issues.detail: The _run loop calls tasks_group.exception() to suppress the very error that just terminated the session, then loops. There is no stated precondition for reconnect, no termination function, and no backoff. The author cannot say under what condition the loop terminates versus reconnects forever. TESTED-NOT-PROVED.

issues.description: _process_stream_event raises APIConnectionError from a synchronous callback inside send_nowait context
issues.detail: On an auth_error or quota_exceeded message, the handler raises from inside recv_task's try/except, which logs the exception and continues the while-True loop. The error is therefore both raised and swallowed. The author cannot state the postcondition on receipt of a fatal error. DEFENSIVE-AS-SUBSTITUTE for correctness.

issues.description: Speaking-state flag is a smuggled goto across coroutine boundaries
issues.detail: self._speaking is mutated from _process_stream_event with no documented invariant: when must it be true, when false, what happens if a committed_transcript arrives before any partial_transcript, or if reconnect occurs mid-segment? The flag survives reconnects unchanged, so END_OF_SPEECH may never fire. SMUGGLED-GOTO.

issues.description: audio_format is derived by string interpolation with no validation against STTAudioFormat
issues.detail: sample_rate is an unconstrained int yet is cast to STTAudioFormat via f"pcm_{sample_rate}". A caller passing sample_rate=11025 produces pcm_11025, which is not in the Literal. The type cast lies; the server rejection is the only check. State the precondition on sample_rate or refuse the input at construction.

issues.description: Author admits tests are broken and shipped no tests; correctness rests on a single manual pipeline run
issues.detail: The PR description states tests were not updated because they are broken since May 2025, citing precedent. This is the canonical TESTED-NOT-PROVED failure mode, made worse: not even tested. No invariant for the WebSocket protocol state machine is written down anywhere. REFUSED until a state-machine specification accompanies the code.

issues.description: Trailing comma inside single-element Literal is gratuitous and the type admits only one model
issues.detail: STTModels = Literal["scribe_v2_realtime",] expresses a one-element set; the parameter is therefore redundant with the default. Either widen the Literal to the models actually supported or remove the parameter. Elegance is not optional.

review.summary: The submission is UNREASONED. No specification is stated for the streaming session: no precondition on sample_rate, no postcondition on close, no invariant on the speaking-state flag, no termination function for the reconnect loop. Error handling raises into a context that immediately suppresses it, and the author concedes there are no tests. The control flow is a familiar modern dress for smuggled goto: a flag mutated from a callback, a while-True with exception().clear() as its only discipline. Refuse until the protocol state machine is written down and the reconnect loop has a stated termination condition.
